title: Khwaab
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the importance of dreaming. He says you may dream to have a good life, a successful career, a family, a house, etc. but a dream results in success only when put to action.

title: Parindey
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about birds being used as a metaphor to represent humans. The expression of birds flying in the sky is generally used to symbolise success, ambitions, carefreeness, prosperity & abundance.
